No source was found publishing the same partial table verbatim, but a failed search does not establish priority; substantive comparison shows textbook restatement + routine dynatomic degrees, not an independent finite-window completeness or new gap extremal.

The partial table plus dynatomic fragment, while honestly described, is an unexplained enumeration fragment / textbook restatement with tiny unmotivated scope (three symmetric points + unicritical line) and no demonstrated downstream calibration use beyond assertion. Intrinsic low value and missing substantive result; no bounded addition without new research (full L, Levy logs, general resultants) would create the claimed value.
